sender.zh: 自稱兒子、女兒、親戚或多年不見朋友的陌生電話，以及同樣暱稱的新LINE帳號
sender.en: An unknown caller claiming to be your son, daughter, relative or an old friend, then a new LINE account with the same name

name.zh: 猜猜我是誰：「我手機換了，加我新的LINE」，接著借錢
name.en: Guess who: “I changed my phone, add my new LINE”, then a request for money

how.zh: 陌生號碼打來，開口就叫爸媽或要你「猜猜我是誰」，自稱是不同住的兒女或親友，說手機掉了、換了新門號，要你在LINE加新帳號。新帳號的LINE暱稱跟本人一樣，有時還用AI模仿親人的聲音。過幾天再以臨時急用、裝潢費等理由要你匯款；匯了一次後又說錢不夠，要再匯到另一個帳戶。
how.en: An unknown number calls, says “Mum” or “Dad” or asks you to “guess who I am”, and claims to be a child or relative who doesn't live with you. They say they lost their phone and changed number, and ask you to add a new LINE account, which has the same display name as the real person; some use AI to copy the relative's voice. A few days later they ask you to transfer money for an emergency or renovation costs, to an account they name; after one transfer they say it's not enough and give another account.

text.zh: 陌生號碼來電自稱是兒女或親友，說手機換了，要你加新LINE。
text.en: An unknown caller says they're your child or relative with a new phone and asks you to add a new LINE.

text.zh: 新LINE帳號暱稱相同，對方聲音也很像。
text.en: The new LINE account has the same display name, and the voice sounds similar.

text.zh: 幾天後說急需用錢，要你匯到指定帳戶。
text.en: Days later they urgently need money and want it sent to an account they name.

text.zh: 匯款後又說不夠，要再匯一筆。
text.en: After you pay, they say it's not enough and ask for more.

text.zh: 媽，是我啦，猜猜我是誰？我手機掉了，這是我的新號碼，你LINE那個舊的刪掉，加我新的帳號喔。
text.en: Mum, it's me, guess who? I lost my phone and this is my new number. Delete the old one on LINE and add my new account.

text.zh: 媽，裝潢的師傅今天要收尾款，我的錢卡在定存領不出來，你可以先幫我匯39萬到師傅的帳戶嗎？下禮拜就還你。
text.en: Mum, the renovation guy wants his final payment today and my money is stuck in a fixed deposit. Can you send 390,000 to his account for me? I'll pay you back next week.

zh: 兒子打電話說手機換了要我加新的LINE
陌生人叫我猜猜我是誰然後說是我姪子
女兒的新LINE說急需用錢要我匯款
說錢要匯到裝潢師傅的帳戶
聲音很像我兒子但其實是詐騙
en: my son called saying he changed his phone and asked me to add his new line
a stranger asked me to guess who it was then said he was my nephew
my daughter's new line account said she urgently needs money
they asked me to send money to the renovation worker's account
the voice sounded just like my son but it was a scam

zh: 陌生號碼來電叫你猜他是誰
說換了手機、要你加新的LINE帳號
急著借錢，匯款後又說不夠
en: An unknown caller asks you to guess who they are.
They say they changed phone and ask you to add a new LINE account.
They urgently want money, then say it is not enough.

zh: 用原本的舊電話號碼打給本人確認
和家人約定只有你們知道的通關密語
還沒確認前不要去銀行匯款；有疑問打165
en: Call the person on the old number you already have.
Agree a family password only you know.
Don't go to the bank until you've checked; call 165 if unsure.

sources.title: 假冒親友詐騙手法翻新　AI變音換暱稱誘騙長輩
慎防釣魚連結及LINE帳號被盜用來詐騙 刑事局籲「不明連結不點、好友借錢先查證」
